metadata.notes: Verified scene workflow over USB ALSA: B1 57 03 selects scene 7 and causes SAVE/RECALL/DELETE to blink; BA 56 03 then executes RECALL of the selected scene. Selection and recall are separate commands.

commands.name: PLAY
commands.description: Playback command. Verified on hardware over the USB ALSA Mixer Control Port with MIDI bytes BA 57 03.

commands.name: FF
commands.description: Not exposed by the official app; investigate separately from physical mixer controls/protocol patterns.

commands.name: REW
commands.description: Not exposed by the official app; investigate separately from physical mixer controls/protocol patterns.

commands.name: SCENE_MODE
commands.description: Enters/activates scene operation mode: SAVE / RECALL / DELETE indicators blink. Verified on hardware over USB ALSA.

commands.name: SCENE_RECALL
commands.description: Triggers RECALL for the currently selected scene. Verified on hardware over USB ALSA.

commands.name: SCENE_SELECT_7
commands.description: Selects scene 7 and leaves scene operation pending: SAVE / RECALL / DELETE blink. A separate SCENE_RECALL command (BA 56 03) is required to activate/load the selected scene.
